title: RNC reveals full keynote speaker list for midterm elections convention
text:
The Republican National Committee announced on Saturday the full list of keynote speakers who will stump for Republican candidates at the midterm elections convention next week.

The first-of-its-kind event, to be held in Dallas, Texas, on Wednesday and Thursday, will feature President Donald Trump as the keynote speaker on Night One, while Vice President JD Vance will take the helm on Night Two, with Trump delivering closing remarks.
